qualification_scope: Owner-authorized Community HACS v0.1.8 TEST source candidate: one-click native HA Config Entry bootstrap with all Controller, ChargeableAsset and Charger configuration handled inside the bundled five-tab MultiCharge dashboard. Beginner users get direct vehicle selection, goals, quick charging modes and STOP; expert users have foldable typed fields for full native Wallbox/Peblar/OCPP source, independent current/power readback, energy, SoC, electrical/circuit, price, solar and schedules, create/delete assets and chargers, and an OPTIONAL bounded copy/paste YAML editor inside dashboard Settings that previews/diffs and applies to the very same Config Entry (never to an external template/file/HA Options dialog). Preserve stable HA Devices/Entities, native service context administration, atomic physical-idle-only reassign, actual planner and safety executor, offline MIT ApexCharts 3.49.1 measured/proposed/accepted/indicative with true price axis. Mandatory release checks: exact dev and squash-merged main source CI, installed Home Assistant 2026.11.2 runtime, actual responsive Chromium and published checksum/source archive. This is a TEST prerelease for subsequent real Wessels hardware/site qualification, not STABLE or physical cutover.
limitations: Wessels Safari/iPad runtime after update, real vendor cable/SoC/current/power states and physical START/STOP/current setpoint readback, circuit/phase limits, site restarts and device transfer remain NOT_RUN. Foundation Mobility F1.8.64 technical registry snapshot is NOT_CAPTURED, not physical qualification: Wallbox current sources identified; Peblar phase current and Utility Plug telemetry still lack live proof. Existing EV Smart Charging remains exclusive physical writer; MultiCharge external-owner until separately commissioned. No Wessels YAML packages/templates are installed. Existing file-owned YAML/JSON imports remain read-only until intentional migration; optional in-dashboard YAML writes only the GUI-managed Config Entry, not a new source/store. Do not infer STABLE/Feature Complete from a green CI or a published prerelease.
